Explicit contractual obligation target; the backend resolves the amount.

Extrato enriquecido para exibição ao hóspede. Null se ainda não fez check-in.

summary.description:
Resumo do ledger materializado deste folio. O saldo agregado da reserva
continua em ReservationFinancialDetails.summary.

grossPaidInCents.description: Pagamentos POSTED lançados neste folio antes de refunds.

openBalanceInCents.description: Saldo devedor do ledger materializado deste folio.

overpaidInCents.description: Crédito excedente do ledger materializado deste folio.

MethodCommercialConfiguration.description:
Complete commercial configuration. Empty purposes authorize nothing; rate/source
semantics are explicit in the Finance policy and never derived from a provider.

NotificationEventStatusDto.description: Processing status of the Notification consumer, independent of message delivery.

PaymentAgreementAmendmentResponse.description:
Idempotent mutation result excludes live inspection so configuration changes
after a lost response cannot change the recovered result.

name.description: Missing descriptor does not erase the historical right.

PaymentMethodConfigurationUpdate.description:
Commercial updates replace current terms in the same transaction as field history.
Name-only updates preserve the financial configuration.

PlatformApplicationFeePolicy.description:
Platform beneficiary, instructed-principal basis and PaymentReceived event.
This collection represents configuration, not recognition or settlement.

folioId.description: Se omitido, lança no primeiro folio OPEN da reserva (cria um se não existir)

reservationId.description: Accepted revision shown by the reservation manual-methods response.

last4.description: Optional historical last four digits. Full PAN/CVV are never accepted here.

oneOf.description: Card network used by a manual card transaction. Required for card methods.

reference.description: Optional provider-independent reference for PIX/bank transfer.

amountInCents.description: Valor total efetivamente recebido. Deve ser igual à soma das allocations.

description.description: Observação livre opcional para o lançamento

installments.description: None = 1 liquidação; Some(n) = quantidade de liquidações previstas do método manual.

oneOf.description: Snapshot do instrumento efetivamente utilizado. Funding é derivado do método.

changes.description: The key is the field name, and the value is the change (old and new value)

feeType.description:

- FeeType::BasisPoints always ignores fee_unit.
- FeeUnit::Guest is only meaningful for FeeType::Fixed.

folios.description: One entry per folio of this reservation
